Initial release of .net-full-stack-architect skill.

- Provides a framework design blueprint for building reusable WebApi services with .NET 6+.
- Integrates key components: SqlSugar (ORM), Swagger (API documentation), JWT (authentication/authorization), and Serilog (logging).
- Supports multi-database types, ELK log integration, and API versioning.
- Offers standardized architecture output, technical integration guidance, and coding best practices templates.
- Prompts users for detailed requirements to tailor architecture recommendations.
